title: Canonicalize equivalent decoder configurations

definition.title: Canonicalize equivalent decoder configurations
definition.source_excerpt: Normalize a constrained H.264 parameter-set representation only when slice instructions and reconstructed pictures remain equivalent. Verify configuration transitions and seeks; profile relabeling is not tool conversion.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Find where bytes/timestamps actually change, are copied, or are withheld. Compare against current persistent mux/parser behavior.
definition.minimum_probe: Construct one bounded positive output and one invalid-edge control using the same coded samples. Keep unrelated fragment/default policies fixed.
definition.initial_screen: Find where bytes/timestamps actually change, are copied, or are withheld. Compare against current persistent mux/parser behavior. Construct one bounded positive output and one invalid-edge control using the same coded samples. Keep unrelated fragment/default policies fixed.
definition.primary_metric: Complete preparation/startup/refill work, bytes and ownership; output parser acceptance alone is not the metric.
definition.scope_contract: Independent parsing of sample payload, configuration, PTS/DTS/duration and required output; valid container plus continuing playback when this is the tested claim.
definition.negative_control: Wrong size/offset/configuration or a non-random-access cut must fail specifically; cancellation cannot publish another generation.
definition.stop_boundary: Do not implement a universal mux engine, virtual file gateway or recovery journal to answer a tiny screen. Escalate scope explicitly.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing parser/mux destination and matching native build where touched; no host-to-Wasm performance extrapolation.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.
